scope_gate: Material changes require a complete ChangeEnvelope. Unmentioned elements remain unchanged.
design_system_gate: Before implementing an interface, inspect the component catalog and record reuse, extend, create, local or not_applicable.
architecture_gate: New complexity requires an observed problem, simpler alternative assessment, owner, fitness function, lifecycle cost, rollback and removal condition.
context_gate: Compile and record the smallest sufficient authoritative dependency subgraph for the Intent.
model_routing: Use the least expensive approved route that meets risk, data and eval thresholds; declare hard ceilings before execution.
usage_accounting: Record exact provider usage when available, estimate immediately, reconcile billed cost later and never treat unavailable as zero.
automation_gate: Remain human-assisted until a repeatable bounded capability has evals, traceability, hard limits and fallback.
promotion_rule: Applicable scenarios require fresh passing evidence; an exception is scoped, compensating, authorized and expiring.
exposure_rule: Use the worst exposure dimension and preserve non-relaxable floors.
forbidden_inferences: budget alert is a hard stop
